_doc: Blind-round eyeball picks for pseudo-claim triage (src/core/pseudo-claim-triage.js).
EMPTY BY DESIGN until the cut exists: the picks are read off AFTER, never tuned to.
Each pick records the group label, the run it was drafted in, and the tier the cut
gave it when it was read off. `expect: KEEP` is a regression the thresholds must keep
satisfying; `knownMiss: true` records a pick the cut did not reach, with the reasons
the cut gave, and is the residue the LLM second cut is for. A threshold is not moved
to reach a pick unless the move is population-justified and the commit says so.
`runs` maps a run name to its sidecar fixture (committed, trimmed to what the picks need
plus a spread of non-picks); test/test_pseudo_claim_triage.js consumes this file.
